items.q: with Teddy Wilson, with Red Norvo, with Mildred Bailey, any number of dates.

ctx.x: Oh perfect. They could play good jazz. Any number of record dates I've been on, I just can't name all of them, but oh goodness, with Teddy Wilson, with Red Norvo, with Mildred Bailey, any number of dates.
How could they cut through in a live situation playing acoustic guitar?
